findings.problem: Calls the knife 'the best self-defense knife for fighting off anything'. Self-defense and fighting talk is banned; Chaku sells utility knives only.
findings.fix: Remove the sentence. Call it a dependable utility knife for camp and trail.

findings.problem: Says 'It never dulls, it never rusts and it can't break'. All three are banned claims.
findings.fix: Say MagnaCut holds an edge and needs regular care, is rust and corrosion resistant, and is built for cutting, not abuse like prying or hammering.

findings.problem: Subject is 69 characters; the limit is 50. It also adds false urgency ('this week only, don't miss out') that we cannot back up.
findings.fix: Shorten to 50 characters or fewer with no urgency, e.g. 'The Chaku V7 is here'.

findings.problem: Preview uses 'this is your last chance to buy one', an unprovable urgency claim. Length (72) is within the 90 limit.
findings.fix: Use a calm, true line, e.g. 'MagnaCut steel that holds an edge on the trail.'

findings.problem: Greeting is 'Hey bro,'. It has no {{first_name}}, and 'bro' is a banned word.
Over-excited language: all-caps 'LAST CHANCE', three exclamation marks, slang ('so fire', 'totally insane'), and false urgency.
findings.fix: Replace with calm, plain copy about the Chaku V7. No caps, at most one exclamation mark, no slang, no urgency.

findings.problem: A second link ('Shop everything' to /sale) breaks the rule of exactly one main link, and it uses a different web address.
findings.fix: Delete the line. Keep only the [Buy now](https://chakuknives.example.com/chaku-v7) link.

findings.problem: Sign-off is 'Cheers, The Chaku team'. It must be 'the Chaku Smiths'.
findings.fix: End the body with 'the Chaku Smiths'.

findings.problem: The required two-line plain-text footer is missing after the sign-off.
findings.fix: Add: 'You're getting this because you joined the Chaku Knives waitlist.' then 'Chaku Knives, {{company_address}} · Unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}'.
